description: Filter the bounded Montgomery County, TX demo property records by a supplied owner-name query. Partial matching is supported, but owner names are not returned. Matching results include addresses, values, property types, and account numbers for the sample records. This is not an owner-verification or people-finder service. Coverage note: the current Montgomery County, TX connector returns demo/sample records only.

owner_name.description: Full or partial owner name to search for

name: property_search_owner
